say:1:1831010001:1.text: My name is Edmund... I'm from the Lightbearer Empire.
say:1:1831010001:1.male: My name is Edmund... I'm from the Lightbearer Empire.
say:1:1831010001:1.female: My name is Edmund... I'm from the Lightbearer Empire.

say:2:1831010002:1.text: They captured me and brought me here to be executed... I escaped, but I didn't get far before something started growing out of my body. These flowers... They pushed their way into my wounds...
say:2:1831010002:1.source_cn: 他们抓了我，送到这里处刑……我跑了。跑出去没多远，身上...
say:2:1831010002:1.male: They captured me and brought me here to be executed... I escaped, but I didn't get far before something started growing out of my body. These flowers... They pushed their way into my wounds...
say:2:1831010002:1.female: They captured me and brought me here to be executed... I escaped, but I didn't get far before something started growing out of my body. These flowers... They pushed their way into my wounds...

say:3:1831010003:1.text: I couldn't go any farther. The soldiers caught up and put a sword through me...
say:3:1831010003:1.source_cn: 我再也走不动了。那些士兵追上来，一剑贯穿了我……
say:3:1831010003:1.male: I couldn't go any farther. The soldiers caught up and put a sword through me...
say:3:1831010003:1.female: I couldn't go any farther. The soldiers caught up and put a sword through me...

say:4:1831010004:1.text: You're... You're a Lightbearer too, aren't you?
say:4:1831010004:1.source_cn: 你是……你也是耀光人，对吗？
say:4:1831010004:1.male: You're... You're a Lightbearer too, aren't you?
say:4:1831010004:1.female: You're... You're a Lightbearer too, aren't you?

say:5:1831010005:1.text: Please take a message home for me. Tell them... I never betrayed anyone.
say:5:1831010005:1.source_cn: 请帮我带句话回去吧，告诉他们……我没出卖任何人。
say:5:1831010005:1.male: Please take a message home for me. Tell them... I never betrayed anyone.
say:5:1831010005:1.female: Please take a message home for me. Tell them... I never betrayed anyone.
